name: Example Project
description: A reusable Hindsight memory bank for reviewed knowledge belonging to one project.
mission: Preserve concise, verified, reusable project knowledge that helps authorized agents understand the project, make consistent decisions, and execute work safely.
scope: Verified implementation details and engineering conventions
Test results, validation evidence, and known limitations
exclusions: Credentials, API keys, tokens, and other secrets
Personal identifiers or unrelated personal history
Bulk copies of authoritative source documents
Transient logs or information with no expected reuse value
